title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
author: J. R. R. Tolkien
summary: A hobbit inherits a ring that turns out to be the one object a dark lord needs to rule everything. With a small company of friends and allies, he leaves home to carry it toward the only place it can be destroyed.
readIf: you want the foundational epic fantasy, with rich landscapes, songs and a slow, immersive journey.
skipIf: you want quick plotting, since the book lingers on travel, history and description.

pairings.reason: The lighter, shorter prequel, if you want to ease into the same world first.
An epic fantasy that clearly grew from this one, with a similar village-to-quest opening.
A shorter, more spare high fantasy that shares the sense of ancient magic and moral weight.
